S.FORM: B tangi sinsanupaimi tu zana iza zana tazianay salalikilan zinku nani.
S.PHON: β taŋi sinsanupaimi tu [z|r]ana i[z|r]a [z|r]ana ta[z|r]ianaj sararikiran [z|r]inku nani
S.FORM: B tangi sinsanupaimi tu zana iza zana tazianay salalikilan zinku nani.
S.PHON: β taŋi sinsanupaimi tu [z|r]ana i[z|r]a [z|r]ana ta[z|r]ianaj sararikiran [z|r]inku nani
S.TRANSL: 我想我們今天來談談那個…這裡的豐年祭活動.
Today let's talk about the Harvest Festival held here.

FORM.notes: source note: Literal translation: 在那之前還有我們的話的演講比賽。

S.FORM: ngayaw na yaupama sa sa bisayan atu iza kwa tu sasikawmaan na S kizaya B zataay zataay sikawmaan zinku nani.
S.PHON: ŋajaw na jaupama sa sa βisajan atu i[z|r]a kwa tu sasikawmaan na s ki[z|r]aja β [z|r]ataaj [z|r]ataaj sikawmaan [z|r]inku nani
S.FORM: ngayaw na yaupama sa sa bisayan atu iza kwa tu sasikawmaan na S kizaya B zataay zataay sikawmaan zinku nani.
S.PHON: ŋajaw na jaupama sa sa βisajan atu i[z|r]a kwa tu sasikawmaan na s ki[z|r]aja β [z|r]ataaj [z|r]ataaj sikawmaan [z|r]inku nani
S.TRANSL: 在那(豐年祭)之前還有母語演講比賽.
Before that (festival), there will be a speech contest of our mother tongue.

S.FORM: aisu bawminankuisu siRab nani.
S.PHON: aisu βawminankuisu siʁaβ nani
S.FORM: aisu bawminankuisu siRab nani.
S.PHON: aisu βawminankuisu siʁaβ nani
S.TRANSL: 我昨天幫妳報名了.
I have signed you up (for the contest) yesterday.

S.FORM: azu yau ni ninu saizaan sa s sanuansu ma qasupaRansu si.
S.PHON: a[z|r]u jau ni ninu sai[z|r]aan sa s sanuansu ma qasupaʁansu si
S.FORM: azu yau ni ninu saizaan sa s sanuansu ma qasupaRansu si.
S.PHON: a[z|r]u jau ni ninu sai[z|r]aan sa s sanuansu ma qasupaʁansu si
S.TRANSL: 如果妳有什麼要講的或知道的,
If there is something you want to tell or (something) you know,

S.FORM: sinsanu iza eh sinsanupaita tazian ya liaotianakita si.
S.PHON: sinsanu i[z|r]a əh sinsanupaita ta[z|r]ian ja ria*tianakita si
S.FORM: sinsanu iza eh sinsanupaita tazian ya liaotianakita si.
S.PHON: sinsanu i[z|r]a əh sinsanupaita ta[z|r]ian ja ria*tianakita si
S.TRANSL: 我們就在這裡用聊天的方式談一談.
We can talk about it here.

S.FORM: azu yau s Raynguanku si.
S.PHON: a[z|r]u jau s ʁajŋuanku si
S.FORM: azu yau s Raynguanku si.
S.PHON: a[z|r]u jau s ʁajŋuanku si
S.TRANSL: 如果我有不懂的地方,
If there is something I don't know,

S.FORM: qawman ipiliku qa tu zataay tu kitut zinku.
S.PHON: qawman ipiriku qa tu [z|r]ataaj tu kitut [z|r]inku
S.FORM: qawman ipiliku qa tu zataay tu kitut zinku.
S.PHON: qawman ipiriku qa tu [z|r]ataaj tu kitut [z|r]inku
S.TRANSL: 當然,至少我還會去聽(去請教)我們的(話).
Of course I will at least listen to (consult) our (language).

S.FORM: S o mwazati Raynguanku qaya tu sikawmaan nani.
S.PHON: s * mwa[z|r]ati ʁajŋuanku qaja tu sikawmaan nani
S.FORM: S o mwazati Raynguanku qaya tu sikawmaan nani.
S.PHON: s * mwa[z|r]ati ʁajŋuanku qaja tu sikawmaan nani
S.TRANSL: 我不了解的話太多了,
There are many words that I don't know.

S.FORM: nianu sa izaan u sasikawmaanku tu zana.
S.PHON: nianu sa i[z|r]aan u sasikawmaanku tu [z|r]ana
S.FORM: nianu sa izaan u sasikawmaanku tu zana.
S.PHON: nianu sa i[z|r]aan u sasikawmaanku tu [z|r]ana
S.TRANSL: 我要講什麼呢?
What should I say?

S.FORM: e B zana kebalan.
S.PHON: ə β [z|r]ana kəβaran
S.FORM: e B zana kebalan.
S.PHON: ə β [z|r]ana kəβaran
S.TRANSL: (講)噶瑪蘭的事.
(Say) something about Kavalan.

S.FORM: S lalikil B lalikil S e la lalikil zinku ngidanku sikawma tu zana lalikil.
S.PHON: s rarikir β rarikir s ə ra rarikir [z|r]inku ŋiɮanku sikawma tu [z|r]ana rarikir
S.FORM: S lalikil B lalikil S e la lalikil zinku ngidanku sikawma tu zana lalikil.
S.PHON: s rarikir β rarikir s ə ra rarikir [z|r]inku ŋiɮanku sikawma tu [z|r]ana rarikir
S.TRANSL: 豐年祭,我想要講的是豐年祭的事.
Harvest Festival, I think I want to talk about the Harvest Festival.

FORM.notes: source note: 指台北的豐年祭和故鄉的不一樣。 | source note: astaR zuma連用和zuma的意思相同，都指「不一樣」。

S.FORM: B m S zinkuay B eN S kasianemiku nani lalikil nani m astaR auN zuma zana tay zana zataay tazian zinku.
S.PHON: β m s [z|r]inkuaj β ən s kasianəmiku nani rarikir nani m astaʁ aun [z|r]uma [z|r]ana taj [z|r]ana [z|r]ataaj ta[z|r]ian [z|r]inku
S.FORM: B m S zinkuay B eN S kasianemiku nani lalikil nani m astaR auN zuma zana tay zana zataay tazian zinku.
S.PHON: β m s [z|r]inkuaj β ən s kasianəmiku nani rarikir nani m astaʁ aun [z|r]uma [z|r]ana taj [z|r]ana [z|r]ataaj ta[z|r]ian [z|r]inku
S.TRANSL: 我想我們這裡的豐年祭好像不太一樣.
I think our Harvest Festival here (in Taipei) is different.

S.FORM: zuma zataay ta pateRungan zinku kya.
S.PHON: [z|r]uma [z|r]ataaj ta patəʁuŋan [z|r]inku kja
S.FORM: zuma zataay ta pateRungan zinku kya.
S.PHON: [z|r]uma [z|r]ataaj ta patəʁuŋan [z|r]inku kja
S.TRANSL: (和)我們新社部落的(豐年祭)不一樣.
I think our (Harvest Festival) in Xinshe is different.

S.FORM: B nayau sayzi nani.
S.PHON: β najau saj[z|r]i nani
S.FORM: B nayau sayzi nani.
S.PHON: β najau saj[z|r]i nani
S.TRANSL: 就是那樣.
Exactly so.

FORM.notes: source note: 講太快了，謝老師說應該是 pasani=pa kilim-an-ku | source note: 老人家的事指的是花蓮那邊的祭典。

S.FORM: S pa payanaypa zinimanku tazian ta sanuanku ta ta zana zata tazian u zana baqian zinku.
S.PHON: s pa pajanajpa [z|r]inimanku ta[z|r]ian ta sanuanku ta ta [z|r]ana [z|r]ata ta[z|r]ian u [z|r]ana βaqian [z|r]inku
S.FORM: S pa payanaypa zinimanku tazian ta sanuanku ta ta zana zata tazian u zana baqian zinku.
S.PHON: s pa pajanajpa [z|r]inimanku ta[z|r]ian ta sanuanku ta ta [z|r]ana [z|r]ata ta[z|r]ian u [z|r]ana βaqian [z|r]inku
S.TRANSL: 我要找的題目是我們這邊的還是老人家的(事情)?
(I'm wondering) whether my topic should be about here or about the elders.

S.FORM: B qawman zana baqianay sikawmaan kawka nengi.
S.PHON: β qawman [z|r]ana βaqianaj sikawmaan kawka nəŋi
S.FORM: B qawman zana baqianay sikawmaan kawka nengi.
S.PHON: β qawman [z|r]ana βaqianaj sikawmaan kawka nəŋi
S.TRANSL: 當然講老人家的話(故事)才好,
Of course about the elders. It would be better.

S.FORM: B yinwei S oh zana baqian.
S.PHON: β jinwəi s *h [z|r]ana βaqian
S.FORM: B yinwei S oh zana baqian.
S.PHON: β jinwəi s *h [z|r]ana βaqian
S.TRANSL: 喔,老人家的.
Oh, about the elders.

FORM.notes: source note: 指東部部落和北部的事情都混在一起了。

S.FORM: B zataay tazian maiita tu S matatapunti.
S.PHON: β [z|r]ataaj ta[z|r]ian maiita tu s matatapunti
S.FORM: B zataay tazian maiita tu S matatapunti.
S.PHON: β [z|r]ataaj ta[z|r]ian maiita tu s matatapunti
S.TRANSL: 都混在一起了.
(All things are) mixed up.

S.FORM: B iza si maiita tu naqunian 'nay waway zemen.
S.PHON: β i[z|r]a si maiita tu naqunian ʔnaj wawaj [z|r]əmən
S.FORM: B iza si maiita tu naqunian 'nay waway zemen.
S.PHON: β i[z|r]a si maiita tu naqunian ʔnaj wawaj [z|r]əmən
S.TRANSL: 因為我們這邊沒有什麼事情(歷史).
Because we don't have history here (in Taipei).

S.FORM: S sepaw mai tu sepaway.
S.PHON: s səpaw mai tu səpawaj
S.FORM: S sepaw mai tu sepaway.
S.PHON: s səpaw mai tu səpawaj
S.TRANSL: 沒有祭祖的(儀式).
Without (ceremonies of) worshiping ancestors,

FORM.notes: source note: 意指演講比賽時要講老人家的事蹟才好。

S.FORM: B nani wama ta zana masangay ni izaan na baqian oN 'nay waway na naquni qawma S m B 'nay kulikuzan kawka nengiay.
S.PHON: β nani wama ta [z|r]ana masaŋaj ni i[z|r]aan na βaqian *n ʔnaj wawaj na naquni qawma s m β ʔnaj kuriku[z|r]an kawka nəŋiaj
S.FORM: B nani wama ta zana masangay ni izaan na baqian oN 'nay waway na naquni qawma S m B 'nay kulikuzan kawka nengiay.
S.PHON: β nani wama ta [z|r]ana masaŋaj ni i[z|r]aan na βaqian *n ʔnaj wawaj na naquni qawma s m β ʔnaj kuriku[z|r]an kawka nəŋiaj
S.TRANSL: 只有跟著以前老人家的事蹟走才是好的.
Only following the elders' behaviors before would be good.

S.FORM: S o en kulikuzita tazana B e S pateRungan kawka.

S.FORM: S o en kulikuzita tazana B e S pateRungan kawka.

S.TRANSL: 我們跟著部落的(話)才好嗎?
It's good for us to follow things in Xinshe?

S.FORM: B an.
S.PHON: β an
S.FORM: B an.
S.PHON: β an
S.TRANSL: 是的.
Yes.

S.FORM: S oh nayauay pasikawmaanku kawka.

S.FORM: S oh nayauay pasikawmaanku kawka.
S.PHON: s *h najauaj pasikawmaanku kawka
S.TRANSL: 喔,我要那樣講才可以嗎?
Oh, should I speak in that way?

S.FORM: B m S o i utani ziqang na.
S.PHON: β m s * i utani [z|r]iqaŋ na
S.FORM: B m S o i utani ziqang na.
S.PHON: β m s * i utani [z|r]iqaŋ na
S.TRANSL: (要講)多久?
How long (should I speak)?

S.FORM: B utulu sanfenchong yinei.
S.PHON: β uturu san*ənʦh*ŋ jinəi
S.TRANSL: 三分鐘以內.
Within three minutes.

S.FORM: S utulu utulu sanfenchong zinna B m m S oh.

S.TRANSL: 規定三分鐘以內.喔.
They said within three minutes. Oh.

We speak in Kavalan (first) and then we speak again in…

After you finish speaking in Kavalan,

S.FORM: S sikawma aita muman tu zana Rulam.

S.TRANSL: 我們再用國語講一次.
We will speak again in Mandarin.

S.FORM: B m an.
S.PHON: β m an
S.FORM: B m an.
S.PHON: β m an

Yes.

S.FORM: mit Rayngu mipil laq tu sikawmaansu tangi si qawman jieshiansu uman aisu ah.
S.PHON: mit ʁajŋu mipir raq tu sikawmaansu taŋi si qawman jiəshiansu uman aisu ah

What did I say just now?

S.FORM: zinsu jienluede S oh B sikawma tu nisikawmaansuay tangi na yisina.

How many people will participate in this activity?

Of course they will watch something of us…
